data.name: Dolphin and Manatee Adventure Tour of Marco Island with Olde Florida History
data.headline: Ages 4+ 2 hours
data.description: Once we set off, your tour guide will be sharing facts about the amazing wildlife and the interesting history of Florida and Marco Island. Guest will have a relaxing time as they paddle through the pristine waters and experience the true beauty of "Natural Florida". While we are on our adventure your tour guide will guide you to all of the areas where we see the most dolphins, manatees, sea turtles, bald eagles, pelicans, osprey, conchs and much more. In fact, there are only a few places in the world to see the West Indian Manatee and Marco Island is one of them! We are conveniently located just minutes from anywhere on Marco. With over 13 years of experience our tours fill up fast so book your tour today.

meeting_point.address: 1969 County Rd 951, Naples Naples, FL US 34113

data.cancellation_notes: Customers will receive a full refund or credit with 24 hours notice of cancellation. Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. Contact us by phone to cancel or inquire about a cancellation. No-shows will be charged the full price.
data.booking_notes:
#We look forward to you joining us!

- ALL GUESTS MUST fill out their own waiver before arriving to the tour site.
   https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/6439726fe3dbb/web/
- Please arrive 20 minutes before your departure time.
- Look for a text message from your tour guide, the day before your tour date, containing any pertinent information about your tour.
- Please wear clothes you are ok with getting wet in, even though you will probably stay dry
- Please pre-apply your sun screen so that your hands are not slippery on your paddles
- Water shoes are recommended to best protect your feet 
- Please drink enough water so that you are hydrated before you arrive.
- We recommend waterproof cell phone bags. Click here to purchase a waterproof cell phone  bag for $12.50 and your tour guide will have your waterproof cell phone bag waiting for you before you start your tour.
 https://threebrothersboards.com/product/waterproof-cellphone-holder/
- We also recommend Sunglass Croakies, especially if you have prescription or expensive glasses. Click here to purchase a Sunglass Croakie for $7.99 and your tour guide will have your Sunglass Croakie waiting for you before you start your tour.
https://threebrothersboards.com/product/original-croakies-eyewear-retainers/
